criteria_verification.criterion_text: `close()` is idempotent and safe to call when client is None
criteria_verification.evidence: GraphitiClient.close() short-circuits when self._inner is None. On the first real close it captures the inner reference, sets self._inner = None *before* awaiting (re-entrancy / concurrent-close safety), then calls inner.close() inside try/except so a raising shutdown cannot propagate. Verified by test_close_is_safe_when_inner_is_none, test_close_calls_inner_close_exactly_once_then_zeros_state, test_close_swallows_inner_close_exceptions — all green on turn 3. Coach turn 2 verified.
